BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE task ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS title varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE task ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS description text;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ti.task_id,
        ti.title,
        ti.description,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ti.task_id
            ORDER BY CASE i.language
                WHEN 'ru' THEN 0
                WHEN 'en' THEN 1
                ELSE 2
            END, i.language
        ) AS rn
    FROM task_i18n ti
    JOIN i18n i ON i.id = ti.i18n_id
),
picked AS (
    SELECT task_id, title, description
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
UPDATE task t
SET
    title = p.title,
    description = p.description
FROM picked p
WHERE p.task_id = t.id;

UPDATE task SET title = '' WHERE title IS NULL;
UPDATE task SET description = '' WHERE description IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE task ALTER COLUMN title SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE task ALTER COLUMN description SET NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
